clues.text: Leah named her second son this, saying the LORD had heard that she was unloved.
He and Levi took their swords into Shechem while its men were still in pain and killed every male.
In Egypt, Joseph took this brother away from the others and had him bound before their eyes.
Joseph's steward told the brothers not to fear over the silver in their sacks, then brought him out to them.
Blessing his sons, Jacob said this son and Levi were brothers whose swords were weapons of violence.
When Joshua divided the land, this son's tribe got its inheritance inside Judah's territory, since Judah's share was too large.
Moses said this son's tribe would stand on Mount Gerizim with Levi, Judah and others to bless the people.
